about: Inventory: rapid selection, and mouse targets that never move away. Scripted input for a capture, not hands-on.

steps.say: RIGHT -- INTO WHAT GOES ON RMB
DOWN x4, 90 MS APART -- EVERY PRESS LANDS; NONE WAITS FOR AN UNFOLD TO FINISH
MOUSE -- HOVER ONLY LIGHTS A STRIP; NOTHING MOVES UNDER THE POINTER
MOUSE -- A CLICK OPENS THE STRIP UNDER THE POINTER, WHERE IT IS
ENTER -- PREVIEW ON RMB: LOCAL, NOT SENT; THE DRAWER'S ORDER DOES NOT CHANGE
